# ADR-3222: AWS network: Documented public ALB for marketing site 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Public ingress is valid for public sites.

## Decision

Web teams MAY adopt a documented public ALB for marketing site 6 (AWS-network-6) when content is intentionally public.

## Consequences

WAF and TLS baselines still apply.
